title: Targeting the c-Myb-CBP/p300 KIX protein-protein interaction with quinone-methide triterpenes: In silico mechanistic insights and MST biochemical validation.
authors: Kamel, Emadeldin M; Rudayni, Hassan A; Allam, Ahmed A; Alfassam, Haifa E; Abalkhail, Adil; Aba Alkhayl, Faris F; Lamsabhi, Al Mokhtar
one_liner_zh: 该文通过虚拟筛选、MD模拟和MST验证研究小分子靶向c-Myb与CBP/p300 KIX的蛋白-蛋白互作界面，虽非TF-DNA结合体系，但聚焦转录因子c-Myb的互作机制且采用物理模拟方法，对TF-DNA界面动态与结合机理建模有方法学借鉴价值。
abstract: The interaction between the transcription factor c-Myb and the CBP/p300 KIX domain is a key regulatory event in transcriptional programs associated with hematologic malignancies, including acute myeloid leukemia, and therefore represents an attractive target for protein-protein interaction (PPI) disruption. In this study, we applied an integrated computational and experimental workflow to identify new quinone-methide triterpenes capable of perturbing the c-Myb-CBP/p300 KIX interface. Using the c-Myb-bound KIX conformation derived from PDB:2AGH as the structural template, a library of 457 quinone-methide-triterpenes was subjected to funnel-based virtual screening. This workflow prioritized isoiguesterin, pristimerin, and tingenone for detailed evaluation. Subsequent 500ns MD simulations revealed distinct ligand-dependent effects on interfacial stability and conformational dynamics. DeltaDeltaG(PPI) analysis showed that tingenone produced the strongest predicted weakening of the c-Myb-KIX interaction (+2.31 kcal/mol), whereas pristimerin had only a marginal disruptive effect (+0.28 kcal/mol) and isoiguesterin instead favored stabilization of the complex (-5.18 kcal/mol). Consistently, free-energy-landscape (FEL) analysis showed that tingenone induced the most heterogeneous conformational ensemble with multiple low-energy basins, while isoiguesterin and Naphthol-AS-E-phosphate favored more restricted low-energy states. Although isoiguesterin showed the most favorable direct binding energetics, it tended to stabilize or compact the interface. Pristimerin displayed an intermediate profile. In contrast, tingenone produced the clearest signatures of interfacial weakening and the most favorable disruption metrics. Experimental validation by microscale thermophoresis (MST) confirmed the direct Myb-KIX interaction (K(d) = 28.49 +/- 2.32 muM) and showed that tingenone was the most potent inhibitor among the tested triterpenes (IC(50) = 23.6 +/- 3.0 muM), outperforming the reference disruptor Naphthol-AS-E-phosphate (IC(50) = 29.0 +/- 1.6 muM). These findings identify tingenone as a promising scaffold for the development of new c-Myb-CBP/p300 KIX PPI inhibitors.
abstract_zh: 转录因子c-Myb与CBP/p300 KIX结构域之间的相互作用是与血液系统恶性肿瘤（包括急性髓系白血病）相关的转录程序中的关键调控事件，因此代表了蛋白质-蛋白质相互作用（PPI）破坏的一个有吸引力的靶点。在本研究中，我们应用了整合的计算与实验工作流程，以识别能够干扰c-Myb-CBP/p300 KIX界面的新型醌甲基三萜类化合物。以源自PDB:2AGH的c-Myb结合KIX构象作为结构模板，对457个醌甲基三萜类化合物库进行了基于漏斗的虚拟筛选。该工作流程优先选择了isoiguesterin、pristimerin和tingenone进行详细评估。随后的500ns分子动力学（MD）模拟揭示了配体依赖性的界面稳定性和构象动力学效应。DeltaDeltaG(PPI)分析显示，tingenone对c-Myb-KIX相互作用产生了最强的预测削弱效应（+2.31 kcal/mol），而pristimerin仅具有微弱的破坏效应（+0.28 kcal/mol），isoiguesterin则反而有利于复合物的稳定化（-5.18 kcal/mol）。一致地，自由能景观（FEL）分析显示，tingenone诱导了最异质的构象集合，具有多个低能盆地，而isoiguesterin和Naphthol-AS-E-phosphate则倾向于更受限的低能状态。尽管isoiguesterin显示出最有利的直接结合能量学，但它倾向于稳定或压缩界面。Pristimerin表现出中间特征。相比之下，tingenone产生了最清晰的界面削弱特征和最有利的破坏指标。通过微量热泳动（MST）进行的实验验证确认了直接的Myb-KIX相互作用（K(d) = 28.49 +/- 2.32 muM），并显示tingenone是所测试三萜类化合物中最有效的抑制剂（IC(50) = 23.6 +/- 3.0 muM），优于参考破坏剂Naphthol-AS-E-phosphate（IC(50) = 29.0 +/- 1.6 muM）。这些发现将tingenone确定为开发新型c-Myb-CBP/p300 KIX PPI抑制剂的有前景的骨架。
